b: The updated release comes with a full bonus album of rarities
Belle And Sebastian's 1996 album If You're Feeling Sinister is getting a 30th anniversary reissue.

The updated release comes with a 13-track bonus album, Lisa Helps The Blind, which comprises unreleased songs, demos and field recordings made by the group between 1995 and 1997. The reissue will be made available digitally in January, and in different vinyl editions in the months after.

One of those physical editions is a 1xLP white-vinyl release, which will feature the full original album only and will be released to record stores.
